name: Starlink Group 15-16
slot_a_text: B1082 usually turns around in about 39 days, and has done it in 25. On that form it should fly again around early December.
slot_b_text: B1082 is flying for the 26th time. It came down on the drone ship Of Course I Still Love You, 574 km downrange. Its previous trip was Transporter 18 (Dedicated SSO Rideshare), 25 days ago.
description: A batch of 27 satellites for the Starlink mega-constellation - SpaceX's project for space-based Internet communication system.
program_description: Starlink is a satellite internet constellation operated by American aerospace company SpaceX
rocket_fact: The Falcon 9 fairing halves are guided back to Earth using onboard thrusters and parafoils to be recovered from the ocean.
